about: Labelled requests for Kural's Model Router: [request, size, kind]. size = how much work: simple (a sentence or a one-line change), standard (a focused task in one place: a function, a fix in a module, an explanation of one part), complex (design or change across many parts, migrations, concurrency, security audits, whole apps). kind = search / explain / edit / review / other. Written for Kural (not taken from any benchmark). MiniLM compares a request with these (nearest neighbours vote); test/router-eval.js measures it with cross-validation.
